clue.text: Passed time, we hear, with eccentric, unexpected participant

a card is a comical or eccentric person

explanation.surface: Someone idles about with an oddball who turned up out of nowhere at an event.
explanation.definitionFit: In sport a wild card is an entrant admitted without qualifying, so an unforeseen competitor.

clue.text: You can't trust me about second love

explanation.definitionFit: To idolise someone is to adore or worship them, a strong form of loving.

clue.text: Dishonest to free up openings for this year

taken as written

the Roman numeral for one

taken as written
taken as written

parts.note: last letter of encounter

clue.text: Surrey town: French are almost here

here missing its last letter

clue.text: Unduly vulgar to use station when travelling

clue.text: Cough upsets Sir at work

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

clue.text: Improper until each reformed

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

the United Kingdom

clue.text: Work in the military force not initially involving too many officers?

the navy, a fighting service, without its first letter

C is the abbreviation for college
